exposure: central sagittal angle of the sacrum (CSAS)
outcome: central sagittal angle of the sacrum (CSAS)
cohort: 53 patients who underwent cesarean delivery under spinal anesthesia
finding: Age, parity, and CSAS appear to be associated with increased risk for persistent LBP 6 months after CS under spinal anesthesia.
mod_finding: This study found an association between cesarean section under spinal anesthesia and persistent low back pain, but it does not specifically analyze different modes of delivery.
